Undergraduate Programme
Our undergraduate programs in Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) offer specialized tracks that empower students with a solid foundation in biological sciences, physical sciences, and Biotechnology. Choosing to pursue a B.Sc. in Biology, PCM, or Biotechnology can be a gateway to diverse career paths and opportunities in various high-demand fields. As industries evolve and new technologies emerge, these programs equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to adapt and excel in their careers.
Bachelor of Science (Pass Course - Biology)
Learning Outcomes: The Bachelor of Science in Biology focuses on the study of living organisms and their interactions with the environment. The curriculum typically includes topics such as: Cell Biology, Genetics and Evolutionary Biology, Ecology and Environmental science, Microbiology and Molecular Biology and Physiology and Anatomy.
Career Opportunities: Graduates with a Bachelor of Science in Biology (B.Sc. Bio) have numerous career opportunities across diverse fields. They can work as laboratory technicians, clinical research coordinators, or ecologists, studying ecosystems for conservation. Opportunities in biotechnology include roles as biotechnologists and quality control analysts. Graduates may also pursue research positions, become educators, or work in regulatory affairs. In agriculture, they can focus on improving crop yields, while roles in forensic science, such as forensic biologists, involve analysing evidence. Additionally, they may find careers in science communication or public health education, often furthering their studies in specialized areas for advanced roles.
Visit Course
Bachelor of Science (Pass Course - Maths)
Learning Outcomes: The B.Sc. PCM program offers a multidisciplinary approach by integrating physics, chemistry, and mathematics. Develop strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Understand the fundamental principles governing physical and chemical systems. Utilize mathematical tools for data interpretation and modeling. The subjects covered usually include: Mechanics, Thermodynamics, and Electromagnetism (Physics) Organic, Inorganic, and Physical Chemistry, Calculus, Algebra, and Statistics (Mathematics).
Career Opportunities: Graduates with a Bachelor of Science in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (B.Sc. PCM) have a wide range of career opportunities. They can work as data analysts, research scientists, or engineers in various industries, including technology and manufacturing. In academia, they may pursue teaching positions or advanced research roles. Opportunities also exist in pharmaceuticals as quality control analysts or regulatory affairs specialists. Graduates can apply their skills in materials science and environmental consulting, or in finance as quantitative analysts. Additionally, positions in actuarial science and computational modeling are available, making a B.Sc. PCM a versatile choice for numerous professional paths.
Visit Course
Bachelor of Science (Biotechnology)
Learning Outcomes: The Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology blends biological sciences with technology. Students explore how biological processes can be utilized in industries such as healthcare, agriculture, and environmental management. Understand the application of biological systems in Technology and Industry. Master laboratory techniques relevant to Biotechnology-Including DNA cloning and Protein purification. Analyze and synthesize Biological data for Innovative solutions. Courses may include: Genetic engineering and Genomics, Bioprocessing and Fermentation Technology, Immunology and Medical Biotechnology and Bioinformatics.
Career Opportunities: Graduates with a Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology have diverse and dynamic career opportunities in various sectors. They can work as Biotechnologists, Research scientists, or Quality control analysts in Pharmaceutical and Biotech companies, contributing to Drug Development and Genetic Research. Opportunities in Agriculture include roles in crop Biotechnology and food production optimization. Many graduates pursue careers in Environmental Biotechnology, focusing on waste management and Bio-Remediation. In addition, they can work in regulatory affairs, ensuring compliance with safety standards, or in sales and marketing roles for Biotech products. Furthermore, advanced studies in related fields can enhance career prospects in academia or specialized Industries.

Welcome to Biyani Girls B.Ed College, Jaipur
Biyani Girls B.Ed. College is founded by “Biyani Shikshan Samiti”. The Samiti is formed by a young, dynamic, and result-oriented team of highly qualified educationists. The College was established in 2006. The mission of the college is to keep pace with the futuristic growing civilized world through women empowerment. The aim of the college is to transform the hidden unlimited potentialities of girls into creativity, empowerment, and prosperity of the nation with humanity. To make the pupil teachers all-rounder the college is providing all facilities which are essential for their betterment.
Biyani Girls B.Ed. College stands tall for its reputation as a top girls college in Jaipur. We offer all courses in the field of education. The following courses that we offer are B.Ed., M.Ed., D.El.Ed., B.Sc.–B.Ed.,B.Ed-M.Ed. To secure a seat in our college the minimum eligibility should be 50% for General and 45% for Reserved Category.
Education has been hit hard by the COVID-19 pandemic with 1.53 billion learners out of school and 184 country-wide school closures, impacting 87.6% of the world’s total enrolled learners. And after thinking about students we are launching an app called “GuruKPO Plus” which provides distance learning to the students. This initiative will help those who cannot attend college during lockdown due to Covid-19 and the people who are in some other colleges and have doubts regarding some subjects. They can always log in to our app and check the videos of their choice. Along with the college-going students, it can also be beneficial for the lecturers to think of applying for a job and need to revise their basics.
We have also adopted the new technology and philosophy in this age of globalization for the sake of the wellbeing of the society and humanity because in the present scenario the students need assurance and confidence that the teacher has the ability to provide the education or ways to the defined goal. And the teacher needs to have a sound knowledge base of the content. Teachers should also have the right attitude and commitment, and here at Biyani, we provide them with the quality education they deserve.
Our Academic Director Dr. Sanjay Biyani is a great orator and career counselor. He came up with the idea of the GuruKPO Plus app during this difficult time to help all the students around the nation. We provide quality education along with moral values, and we also inculcate the quality that a teacher should have with the help of our Personality Enhancement Program (PEP). We have also hosted some international conferences like BICON in collaboration with different universities in Japan. We also encourage the students to take part in Creative Club and Extra-Curricular activities because a teacher needs to be versatile to provide students with quality education.
In the end, all I can say “Choose Quality, Choose Biyani for a better start for your future”.

Re-Imagine Education Program and its beneficiary course
The Re-Imagine Education Program and its beneficiary course is an effort to reimagine the current system of education by making the learners of today, teachers of tomorrow by equipping them with 21st-century skills.
Innovations in pre-service teacher education are the unexplored levers of change that can drastically improve the quality of our education system in the long run. Since we want our next generation to be equipped with 21st-century skills, it is essential that our teachers are prepared to teach in this new education paradigm. This program focuses on building foundational skills which form the basis of higher-order 21st-century skills like critical thinking, problem-solving, digital fluency, empathy, and collaboration.
Employability skill under life skill course basically introduced for developing communication skills as well as soft skills of students.
Main learning objectives of Rubicon program are following:-
The Cyber security Essentials course is designed for students who are interested in pursuing more advanced studies in the field of cyber security. This preparatory course provides with an overview of the cyber security field. The
colleges, career and technical schools, and community centers.
This course is an analysis of an existing radio station’s format. The station may be from the local area provided you have enough information about the station to conduct a full analysis (i.e. tapes or listening to the station via the World Wide Web). In this assignment include: station call letters, dial position, music, announcing style, format clock (overall or for day part), rotation, use of on-air personalities, promotional package, slogans, stop sets, etc. Analysis should detail how a station meets the needs of its target audience. For example if a station has a format that appeals to teens, do the commercials aired on the station target that audience? Analyses will be shared in class.
The certificate program of art and craft, adds one more feather in the cap of  professional skills of our students. It helps trainee teachers to improve their communication skills, creativity of presentation, innovative methods of making TLM, an artistic approach towards learning and explaining difficult topics with visual perception, imagination with model and creative projects. Innovative TLM projects makes difficult intangible topics easier such as linguistic concepts, poems and prose.
The certificate programme consists of practice based exercises on water colouring, colour mixing concept, clay modelling, TLM making, sketching and sculpturing.

    Our undergraduate programs in Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) offer specialized tracks that empower students with a solid foundation in biological sciences, physical sciences, and Biotechnology. Choosing to pursue a B.Sc. in Biology, PCM, or Biotechnology can be a gateway to diverse career paths and opportunities in various high-demand fields. As industries evolve and new technologies emerge, these programs equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to adapt and excel in their careers.

    -- 1047- 1048- 1049: Bachelor of Science (Pass Course - Biology) 1050-
    1051- 1052:

    Learning Outcomes: The Bachelor of Science in Biology focuses on the study of living organisms and their interactions with the environment. The curriculum typically includes topics such as: Cell Biology, Genetics and Evolutionary Biology, Ecology and Environmental science, Microbiology and Molecular Biology and Physiology and Anatomy.

    Career Opportunities: Graduates with a Bachelor of Science in Biology (B.Sc. Bio) have numerous career opportunities across diverse fields. They can work as laboratory technicians, clinical research coordinators, or ecologists, studying ecosystems for conservation. Opportunities in biotechnology include roles as biotechnologists and quality control analysts. Graduates may also pursue research positions, become educators, or work in regulatory affairs. In agriculture, they can focus on improving crop yields, while roles in forensic science, such as forensic biologists, involve analysing evidence. Additionally, they may find careers in science communication or public health education, often furthering their studies in specialized areas for advanced roles.

    Learning Outcomes: The B.Sc. PCM program offers a multidisciplinary approach by integrating physics, chemistry, and mathematics. Develop strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Understand the fundamental principles governing physical and chemical systems. Utilize mathematical tools for data interpretation and modeling. The subjects covered usually include: Mechanics, Thermodynamics, and Electromagnetism (Physics) Organic, Inorganic, and Physical Chemistry, Calculus, Algebra, and Statistics (Mathematics).

    Career Opportunities: Graduates with a Bachelor of Science in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (B.Sc. PCM) have a wide range of career opportunities. They can work as data analysts, research scientists, or engineers in various industries, including technology and manufacturing. In academia, they may pursue teaching positions or advanced research roles. Opportunities also exist in pharmaceuticals as quality control analysts or regulatory affairs specialists. Graduates can apply their skills in materials science and environmental consulting, or in finance as quantitative analysts. Additionally, positions in actuarial science and computational modeling are available, making a B.Sc. PCM a versatile choice for numerous professional paths.

    1073- 1074:

    Learning Outcomes: The Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology blends biological sciences with technology. Students explore how biological processes can be utilized in industries such as healthcare, agriculture, and environmental management. Understand the application of biological systems in Technology and Industry. Master laboratory techniques relevant to Biotechnology-Including DNA cloning and Protein purification. Analyze and synthesize Biological data for Innovative solutions. Courses may include: Genetic engineering and Genomics, Bioprocessing and Fermentation Technology, Immunology and Medical Biotechnology and Bioinformatics.

    Career Opportunities: Graduates with a Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology have diverse and dynamic career opportunities in various sectors. They can work as Biotechnologists, Research scientists, or Quality control analysts in Pharmaceutical and Biotech companies, contributing to Drug Development and Genetic Research. Opportunities in Agriculture include roles in crop Biotechnology and food production optimization. Many graduates pursue careers in Environmental Biotechnology, focusing on waste management and Bio-Remediation. In addition, they can work in regulatory affairs, ensuring compliance with safety standards, or in sales and marketing roles for Biotech products. Furthermore, advanced studies in related fields can enhance career prospects in academia or specialized Industries.

    A Bachelor of Computer Application degree is the core of Computer Science in today’s world. BCA is a three-year degree program. This degree is for those who want to study computer science, software engineering, information technology, information security, and networking technology.

    A Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) Degree is a professional degree that universities offer. The course is designed to provide students with the knowledge and skills required to succeed in computer science and information technology.

    The primary goal of this course is for students to understand what it means to be a BCA, what skills they need, and how they will develop those skills during their time at college. The secondary goal is for students to understand what it takes to succeed in their studies while working toward becoming professional BCAs.

    The BCA course is highly regarded in the IT industry and provides students with a wide range of career opportunities. Graduates of the MCA course can work in various roles, such as software developers, web designers, system analysts, database administrators, and more.

    BCA course mainly covers programming subjects such as C,C++,JAVA ,Python etc, Database concepts, Networking concepts, Operating System, Computer Architecture, Mobile application development, Applied mathematics concepts etc.

    Eligibility: 

    6 Semester (3 Years Program)

    As per University norms, candidate must have passed 10+2 examination (Arts/Science/Commerce) or equivalent with securing 48% or more (minimum pass marks of SC/ST/OBC/SOBC candidates) in aggregate without any approximation.

    Note: Medium of instruction and examination will be English only.

    Syllabus Link : https://rtu.ac.in/index/syllabusfilter.php?id=1

    A two-year professional post-graduate degree called the Master of Computer Applications (MCA) is available to those who desire to learn more about the development of computer applications. A combination of practical and theoretical information is taught throughout the curriculum. Students who earn an MCA degree have the chance to work with tools designed to create applications more quickly and effectively.

PCM) have a wide range of career opportunities. They can work as data analysts, research scientists, or engineers in various industries, including technology and manufacturing. TITLE: Q.1. What is the B.Sc. Science Programme at Biyani?
BODY: Ans: | The B.Sc. Science Programme is a comprehensive undergraduate course designed to build strong scientific knowledge along with practical skills. It offers specializations in Biology, Mathematics, and Biotechnology, focusing on academic excellence, research orientation, and industry relevance.
TITLE: Q.2. What B.Sc. programmes are offered at Biyani Girls College?
BODY: Ans: We offer future-ready undergraduate programmes: | B.Sc. Biology (CBZ) – Explore life, health & environment | B.Sc. Mathematics (PCM) – Build logic, technology & innovation | B.Sc. Biotechnology – Bridge biology with cutting-edge technology
TITLE: Q.3.What is the duration and eligibility of the programme?
BODY: Duration: 3 Years/4 Year (6 Semesters/8 Semester) | Eligibility: 10+2 (Science stream) from a recognized board
TITLE: Q.4. What makes this programme unique at Biyani?
BODY: Ans: The programme combines academic rigor with practical exposure, including modern laboratories, research-based learning, industry interaction, and skill development aligned with AI and emerging technologies.
TITLE: Q.5 How does the programme ensure practical learning?
BODY: Learning is driven by hands-on experience through modern laboratories, live projects, industrial visits, internships, and exposure to in-house research platforms like Biyani BioSolutions Pvt. Ltd., enabling students to connect theory with real-world applications.
TITLE: Q.6. What is the different between B.Sc. Pass Course and B.Sc. Honours Degree?
BODY: Ans:  B.Sc. Pass course is a traditional course, which fulfils the requirement and eligibility for seating in the Govt. and public sector examination in India. It is well known and popular degree course in all the universities in India, whether, B.Sc. (Hons.) is specifically subject dominated course, which only focuses on one particular area of science, and therefore limited job opportunities exist with this course.
TITLE: Q.7.What career opportunities are available after completing B.Sc.?
BODY: Ans.B.Sc. graduates may go for higher studies in  M.Sc./ M.Sc. (by research ), PhD and MBA courses, besides it they have options for fascinating govt. jobs with high paid salary. Civil Services, Banking, and Finance sector, Defense services (like AFCAT, CDS, Indian Army, Air Force, etc.).  The students those are interested in the school teaching may join B.Ed. course just immediately after the B.Sc.
TITLE: Q.8 Are there opportunities for research and innovation?
BODY: Ans Yes. Students are encouraged to participate in research projects, seminars, workshops, and scientific events, fostering innovation, critical thinking, and scientific inquiry.
TITLE: Q.9. Does the programme include industry exposure?
BODY: Ans. Absolutely. The curriculum integrates industrial visits, internships, expert lectures, and skill-based training, ensuring students understand real-world applications of science.
TITLE: Q.10. Can I explore opportunities beyond India?
BODY: Yes. With international collaborations, especially with Japan and global institutions, students gain exposure that builds confidence, competence, and global career pathways.
TITLE: Q.11 How does the programme prepare students for future careers?

Courses We Offer

Courses We Offer
Scholarships Programme
Certificate Programmes
Biyani Group of Colleges offers various certificate programs. These programs incorporate workshops, practicals, assignments, influential presentations and movie clippings. Certificate programs are taken by trainers who are experts in their respective fields and all the courses are open for students of all streams. In each academic session, students have an option to opt for any one of the following certificate programs.
This certificate programme helps the students to enhance their personality by improving their gestures, expressions, body language, communication skills. The programme consists of exercises based on co-operation & co-ordination, imagination, self discussion, observation and acting with music and tools etc.
Personal grooming is an important aspect of personality these days as an attractive body language is defined by good dressing sense too. The effect of good colours on the body and mind is pleasing, relaxing or exciting. A good dressing sense includes latest colour combinations, fits, necks etc. which are according to the body structure (height, complexion etc.) and occasion. This course consists of knowledge of fabrics, falls & textures, give an introduction of neck lines & prints, lines foundation & geometric forms etc.
Martial art is a Japanese art and in today’s era, learning and developing skills of self protection and self defense is extremely important especially for girls. Hence, this art not only makes the learners strong but also enhances concentration, intellectual capacity, self confidence and physical fitness. It covers techniques, like, Kicks, Blocking and Self Defense.
A student of commerce knows about accountancy, but this programme gives them an exposure to maintain accounts manually. Though most of the accounting is done on computers today but a student must be aware of manual accounting. It consists of Preparation of Vouchers, Basics of accounting, Preparation of Ledgers & Subsidiary Books etc
Basics Of Retail Management
The course in retail management aims at providing avenues, opportunities and methodology of retail management, the knowledge of which is essential to survive in this giant sector. It covers topics like Customer Service and Selling Skills, Visual Merchandising, Equipment Handling, Retail Security, Crisis Management and SupplyManagement. Many professionals and students take this course because of growth, expansion and specialized techniques used in this sector.
This course is designed for those students who wish to develop expertise on specific emerging areas of Bioinformatics. The curriculum is designed as a broad-based learning experience which provides the students an in-depth, latest knowledge about Bioinformatics area as well as the technology used in management and retrieval of pharmaceutical information. The course content comprises of Areas of Bioinformatics, Information Technology for Bioinformatics, Biological data bases (NCBI, PDB, Uniprot, KEG, NCBI-Genome), Protein/Protein structure prediction (Methods), Linux for Bioinformatics etc.
Memory Enhancement Programme
This programme focuses on the enhancement of concentration, observation and awareness, by using memory enhancing techniques. It helps the students to remember long theories, difficult words, digits, names and faces etc. The trainer focuses on the methods for improving memory, Triangle exercise, Concentration exercise, Phonetic method, tips for good memory, P.M.S. method and Effective study methods etc
Graphic design is the study and practice of communicating ideas and information through printed, environmental, and digital presentations. People who are creative or have a flair for colours and nature can step ahead in this field by taking this course. It covers intensive modules such as Typography Attribute, Alignment Guideline, Page Layout, Table Creation and Text procedures etc. It also acts as an additional qualification with management, commerce & IT courses.
French is a official language in 29 countries across five different continents and the fourth most widely spoken mother tongue in European union. Hence, making it one of the most important language of the world. The knowledge of French can give you an edge if you intent to make your career at the global level. It is considered to be one of the easiest languages to be learn by English speakers. Its Latin roots makes its closer to English. This certificate course focuses mainly on, how to read, write and speak the language.
Today’s youth aspires to become electronic & print media journalists. With this motive, this certificate programme covers Reporting & Editing in Print & Electronic Media, Photo Journalism, Film Journalism etc. This course emphasizes on cartoon making and preparing power point presentations. Preparing documentary and writing script for TV & Radio is an essential part of the curriculum of this course.
Certificate Course in Dance
Dance lays emphasis on body movements and rhythm and hence improves personality and physical fitness. It also enhances the level of confidence and relaxes the body keeping one mentally and physically healthy. This course includes basic steps of Indian Dancing (Jumps, Walking, Spinning Hands and Neck Movements), Basic steps of western dance and few steps of Punjabi, Belle and Latin American Dance forms (Salsa, Jive, Bacchante etc.).
Japanese Language
This course is a bright opportunity for those who would like to try their hands at a new language and dip their toes in the oriental world. It aims at providing sufficient knowledge of Japanese language for working and interacting with Japanese. It is also very helpful for those who would like to learn some quick Japanese before visiting the Land of the Rising Sun. This certificate course focuses mainly on, how to read, write and speak the language.
Certificate Course in DanceaSpoken English
We realize the importance of English as an official language in this contemporary corporate era. In order to enable students to communicate effectively in English, this certificate course focuses mainly on Spoken English, Pronunciation, Usage of Grammar and Vocabulary Enhancement. This is a one-month programme for all the streams. We hope that this endeavour truly synchronizes with our mission of technical education.
Looking into the present pensive state of violent affairs and aggression, we have come up with an innovative step of introducing certificate course in the Principles and Ideals of Geeta & Gandhism. Geeta, the sacred text, teaches us to believe in the omnipresent God and the Karmas, whereas the father of the nation always believed in nonviolent ways of resolving conflicts. This course will thus inculcate these values in our students.
This programme is designed to cater to the needs of the travel industry in the wake of the phenomenal influx of foreign tourism in India. It not only provides entry level positions for the certificate holders but also employment opportunities to the innovative and confidence candidates. It focuses on the classification of Hotels, Front office, House Keeping, Sales & Marketing, Banqueting etc.
German Language
Learning a new language is always fun and gives you an edge if you intent to work in a multinational company. German is mainly spoken in Central Europe and is the official language of Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy and Belgium. It is quiet similar to English having Latin roots. Your knowledge of German will bring you closer to the European history. This certificate course focuses mainly on, how to read, write and speak the language.

Japanese Language

Yoga & Meditation

Principles and deals of Gita & Gandhism

This course will thus inculcate these values in our students.
